priorities_note: No improvement priorities: the measurements from this clip do not support any.

undetermined.title: Left-right balance
undetermined.reason: Needs both arms followed through whole pulls. From the side the far arm is hidden behind the body for part of every pull.

undetermined.title: Arm coordination
undetermined.reason: Needs the start and end of both arms' pulls. The far arm's are hidden from a side view.

undetermined.title: Kick rhythm
undetermined.reason: Kick beats are computed but have not been checked against video yet, and the far leg is often hidden.

undetermined.title: Breathing timing
undetermined.reason: The head turn is not seen reliably from an underwater side view; the experimental detector has not been checked against video.

undetermined.title: Body rotation
undetermined.reason: Rotation around the body's long axis cannot be measured from one side camera. It needs a front or overhead view.

undetermined.title: Propulsion and efficiency
undetermined.reason: Force and efficiency cannot be measured from video of joint positions alone.

undetermined.title: Change since earlier swims
undetermined.reason: This is a baseline: there is no earlier swim that can be compared with it.

undetermined.title: Whether any value is good or bad
undetermined.reason: No reference values have been verified for these measurements, so nothing is compared with other swimmers or with an ideal.

undetermined.title: What matters most to you
undetermined.reason: The profile has no goals yet, so findings are not ranked by them.

rules.title: Body line or leg line judged as better or worse
rules.reason: Not active. It needs a verified source for how body and leg line relate to drag or speed for swimmers of this level, and a check that the picture angle measures it.

rules.title: Head position judged as better or worse
rules.reason: Not active. It needs a verified source on head position in freestyle, and a head measure that separates lifting from turning to breathe.

rules.title: Stroke rate judged against the distance or the swimmer's level
rules.reason: Not active. It needs swim speed or distance per stroke for the clip (not measured) and verified reference ranges for the swimmer's level and event.

rules.title: Elbow bend, pull depth or pull path judged
rules.reason: Not active. It needs arm points that can be trusted through the whole pull (Phase 2 left wrist placement at the end of the push unresolved) and a second camera view.
